title: Variational derivation of the Flamant solution for a nonlinear elastic wedge
summary: Concentrated forces acting at the tip of a two-dimensional wedge give rise to the classical Flamant solution to linear elasticity, whose displacement and strain are singular at the tip of the wedge. Starting from nonlinear elasticity, we prove that the Flamant solution gives the leading order response of a slightly truncated wedge to small boundary displacements or loads.
